$doc: Deterministic fixture data for all 24 exercise types. Consumed by scripts/seed_qa.py (Python) and by future frontend e2e registry (TypeScript). Sync is enforced at seed-time (raises SystemExit if any ExerciseType enum value lacks a fixture). Lifecycle-test fields (sampleCorrectAnswer / sampleWrongAnswer / rendererSelector / submitSelector) are added separately when the Playwright lifecycle spec is wired up - see docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-22-qa-system.md Phase 5.

fixtures.label: Code Challenge
fixtures.$note: A program, not a function: the sandbox feeds test_case.input on stdin and compares stdout with expected_output. The earlier def add(a, b) pair read nothing and printed nothing, so the reference solution failed its own two cases and the exercise was unsolvable as written. backend/tests/test_qa_fixtures.py now runs this solution against these cases.

config.starter_code:
a, b = map(int, input().split())
# Print their sum.
config.solution_code:
a, b = map(int, input().split())
print(a + b)

fixtures.label: SCORM package
fixtures.$note: No package on purpose, and the keys are the ones the player reads: package_id and launch_url. The earlier package_url was read by nobody - scorm-package-exercise.tsx asks /scorm-import/packages/{package_id}/launch-token and opens launch_url - and pointed at /static/qa-fixtures/placeholder-scorm.zip, which 404s. Both roads led to the same 'ask your teacher to upload one' screen; this one says so honestly. Authoring a package the CMI wiring can drive is its own work.
fixtures.skipReason: Requires a real SCORM .zip uploaded via /api/v1/scorm-import; covered by manual smoke for now.

config.problem: Find the volume of this cone.

fixtures.label: Crossword
fixtures.$note: grid_size + words[] with row/col/direction is the shape both sides actually read: the renderer's adapter in v2-exercise-live.tsx and _grade_crossword_detail, which walks content['words'] and compares w['word']. The earlier grid_width/grid_height/clues[] shape was read by neither, so the board rendered as an empty 10x10 default with no clues at all - and since that grader answers 1.0/True when it finds no words, the unsolvable exercise scored full marks too.

fixtures.label: Map pin drop
fixtures.$note: image_url, not map_url: the config panel and both widgets read image_url, and map_url was read by nobody - so the map never appeared even when the file existed. The file itself ships with the frontend at public/exercise-assets/world-map.svg; the earlier /static/qa-fixtures/world-map.png was served by nobody and answered 404 in production.

fixtures.label: Bubble sheet
fixtures.$note: questions[] with a per-question `correct` letter is the shape both sides read: _grade_bubble_sheet_detail walks content['questions'] and compares q['correct'], and v2-exercise-live turns that letter into the option index the widget draws. The earlier question_count/choices_per_question/correct_answers shape was read by neither, so the card rendered with no bubbles and the grader, finding nothing to mark, awarded 100 to every submission - an empty one included.
